subject: Copywriting
title: Coffee House Ads
description: Learn Coffee House Ads in one minute.

hook.text: London's 1600s coffee houses were hubs of business. Their walls were covered in handwritten ads.

buildup.text: Lloyd's of London started as a coffee house where shipping ads were posted. Insurance was born there.

discovery.text: Coffee house ads were targeted by location. Financial ads near the exchange, literary ones near theaters.

twist.text: The government tried banning coffee houses in 1675, fearing the free flow of ideas and commerce.

climax.text: Today's social media feeds—ads mixed with conversation—mirror exactly what coffee houses did in 1680.

punchline.text: Social media is just a digital coffee house. Ads included.

quiz.question: What major institution originated from a London coffee house?
